title: Four user-supplied technical-analysis ideas on crypto, futures and CFDs
source: user request 2026-10-30: Triple EMA ribbon alignment; HMA slope turn (and whether TEMA helps); pin-bar rejection wick; slow-EMA trend pullback continuation
bars: daily bars; signal at the bar close, position held from the next bar (no same-bar fill)

variants.ribbon: EMA 8 / 21 / 55 of close: long when EMA8 > EMA21 > EMA55, short when EMA8 < EMA21 < EMA55, else flat
variants.hma: HMA(21) = WMA(2*WMA(close,10) - WMA(close,21), 4): long while the HMA slope is up (HMA_t > HMA_t-1), short while down (a slope turn flips the position)
variants.hma_tema: hma, but long only when also close > TEMA(21) and short only when close < TEMA(21) (TEMA = 3*E1 - 3*E2 + E3, EMA span 21); else flat
variants.pinbar: bullish pin: lower wick >= 0.6 * range, body <= 0.3 * range, and low <= the lowest low of the previous 10 bars; bearish mirror with the upper wick and the 10-bar high; hold 5 bars in the signal direction (a newer signal replaces an older one)
variants.pullback: uptrend = EMA50 > EMA200 and close > EMA200; long entry when the previous close <= EMA20 and the close > EMA20 (pullback resumed); exit at close < EMA50, after 20 bars, or on an opposite entry; short is the mirror image

parameters: fixed textbook values above, no tuning; 5 variants x 3 markets = 15 trials
sizing: per instrument position = signal * 0.10 / (60-day realised vol, annualised, lagged one bar), capped at 3x; sleeve = mean over instruments

crypto.data: Binance USDT-M perpetuals (binance_pack), daily bars 00:00 UTC, P&L hourly
crypto.costs: 7.5 bp per unit turnover (Bybit/Binance taker 5.5 bp + 2 bp half spread) + actual funding paid / received
crypto.judge: add the sleeve to v9.8 (v95 sleeves minus cascade + event_live listing short) via portfolio_v5; pass = book Sharpe >= reference + 0.05 AND no period lower (project strict rule)

futures.universe: the 24 non-crypto CME markets of futures_db.NONCRYPTO
futures.data: Databento hourly front contract, aggregated to the CME trading date; back-adjusted with roll-safe returns (OHLC of the day's final contract scaled to the adjusted close)
futures.costs: futures_db.cost_frac (one tick + commission) per unit turnover
futures.judge: add to the current 15-sleeve book (fbook.build, read-only: nothing is saved); pass = book 2023-26 >= reference + 0.05 AND 2010-17 and 2018-22 not lower; also reported: stand-alone futures_db.passes and the ES/NQ beta appraisal

cfd.universe: every Dukascopy 1h series except BTCUSD / ETHUSD (crypto covered above): 14 index, 13 FX, 2 metal, 3 energy, copper, 2 bond CFDs
cfd.data: Dukascopy hourly bid, resampled to UTC days (weekdays)
cfd.swap: main case swap-free account (as the BrightFunded books); sensitivity: 3%/yr financing on gross exposure
cfd.judge: stand-alone futures_db.passes-style rule (period 1 > 0, period 2 >= 0.5, period 3 >= 0.3) AND adding to the Gen201 index-CFD book raises 2023-26 by >= 0.05 with 2021-22 not lower

promotion: nothing is promoted without the user's explicit OK; v9.8 stays frozen
